name: Gauge
tagline: How far you are, and how long is left.
description: A thin reading-progress bar for every long page, with the time left to read. Frosted settings panel; works on phones too.
intro: Gauge adds a thin progress bar to long pages and shows roughly how many minutes of reading are left, so you always know how far you are.

rows.title: Show the progress bar
rows.desc: A thin bar that fills as you scroll

rows.title: Show time left
rows.desc: A small chip with the minutes still to read

features: A bar that fills as you read
A thin bar in your chosen color fills from left to right as you scroll a long page.
A small chip shows roughly how long the rest of the page takes at your reading speed.
Short pages stay untouched; the bar and chip appear only when there's real reading to do.
The panel follows your device's light or dark setting, or pick one with the switch at the top.
